verdict_reason: Endpoints accept unvalidated input: a missing species-check body returns 200 with nothing missing, and non-numeric page/size or malformed JSON surface as 500 instead of 400.

todos.issue: The controller accepts its input unchecked, so a bad request is answered as success or as a server fault: (a) line 36 @RequestBody(required = false) with no @Valid means a POST /commodities/species-check with no body, or with lines missing code/latinName, returns 200; an empty body gives {"missing":[]}, which tells the frontend every species is still listed; (b) lines 27-28 page/size have no @Min/@Max, so page=-1 or size=500 are silently clamped by the service and echoed back as different values; (c) a non-numeric page/size (MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException) or malformed JSON (HttpMessageNotReadableException) are RuntimeExceptions, so GlobalExceptionHandler.handleException answers 500 'unexpected error' and logs at ERROR instead of 400.
todos.fix: Must: invalid input to both endpoints is refused with a 400 ProblemDetail (missing body, null lines, a line without code or latinName, page < 0, size outside 1..100, non-numeric page/size, malformed JSON), and only a well-formed request reaches the services. One way: make the body required with @Valid, add @NotNull/@NotBlank to SpeciesCheckRequest.lines and CommodityLine components, annotate the class @Validated with @Min(0) page and @Min(1) @Max(100) size, and add 400 handlers for MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException, HttpMessageNotReadableException and ConstraintViolationException in GlobalExceptionHandler; drop the service-side clamping and null-body fallbacks it replaces.

todos.issue: The search query parameter is named 'search' (line 26, value = "search"), where the REST guide names the default search parameter 'q' (and MDM's own /search takes 'q'). The Java parameter is 'searchTerm', so one concept carries three names across frontend URL, controller and MDM call.
todos.fix: Must: the default search parameter on GET /commodities follows the REST guide's name for it, the same in the frontend client (client.js fetchCommodities), the stub repo and the reference-data controller. One way: rename to @RequestParam(value = "q", required = false) String q and update the frontend client and trade-imports-stub in the same branch.
